originalBrief: Design an extraordinary $25m contemporary tropical waterfront mansion in Saint Lucia, on a flat site. Create a sophisticated luxury residence with a distinctive entrance, beautiful living spaces, private bedroom wings, purposeful upper-level architecture where appropriate, and integrated outdoor living. Choose a coherent architectural concept using relevant knowledge and construction capabilities. The result should feel like a remarkable luxury estate, not a basic bungalow. Construct fully editable direct-scene architecture.
